inventory-sorter.sort_mode.name: Name
inventory-sorter.config.title: Inventory Sorter
inventory-sorter.config.sort_mode.toolti:
Item Type: similar items together (stone, wood, ores, tools...)
Name: A to Z
Item ID: by the minecraft:... id
Count: biggest piles first
Mod: grouped by the mod that adds the item
Right-click a sort button to cycle this.
inventory-sorter.config.reverse_order.to: Sort the other way round, for example Name Z to A.
inventory-sorter.config.include_hotbar.t:
Sorting and Move All on the player inventory
also take the hotbar.
Sorting uses normal inventory clicks, so it works on any server.
Instant sends them all at once.
Lower it if a server's anti-cheat complains.
inventory-sorter.config.player_inventory: Show buttons on your own inventory as well as on the container.
inventory-sorter.config.player_buttons_i:
Also show the player inventory buttons in crafting tables,
furnaces, anvils and other vanilla screens.
